summary: Improved the Three.js wheel and selector with layered geometry, instanced rivets, mechanical pointer movement, selected-sector highlight and bounded GPU resources.
scope: C:/Users/albyw/source/Ruota-del-Tempo; NAS KB/closure bridge only; NAS CBMM does not index this Windows repository.

changes.what: Layered wheel, merged vertex-colored sectors, instanced rivets, beveled pivoting pointer, winner highlight and two-model GPU cache.
changes.evidence: Production and Vite dev browser tests: 15 draw calls, <=30 geometries, <=3 textures through four mode/language combinations.

changes.what: Frame-independent pointer deflection from analytical angular velocity; muted/paused detent audio; no animated rotations for reduced motion; SVG winner highlight.
changes.evidence: Three experiment unit tests pass; full browser rounds, pointer movement/rest, pause, focus, context loss and initial WebGL denial pass.

changes.what: GPU budget regression checks and navigation synchronization for dev/remote origins.
changes.evidence: npm run test:experiment:browser passed against built distribution and Vite dev server.

improvements.problem: Software-rendered headless browser does not measure phone GPU, battery or subjective readability.
proposals: Evaluate the trial on a physical phone before making it the default.

improvements.problem: Trial needs about 697 kB application JS versus 278 kB classic.
proposals: Keep the trial separate and load Three only on its dedicated entry.

improvements.problem: Nine preexisting npm audit findings remain in Vite/Tailwind dependencies.
proposals: Plan a separate tested major-version toolchain upgrade.
